notes.title: Update v1.9.11 adds a new VR Cinema to CINEVEO. The Haunted Valley v2.0!
notes.content:
We are super excited to announce the release of the v1.9.11 update. This major update adds a new VR Cinema environment to CINEVEO. One that is perfect for horror movies. Welcome to the new Haunted Valley!

[h1][b]CINEVEO's Haunted Valley v2.0[/b][/h1]

[b]SPECIAL FEATURES[/b]
Eerie environment ideal for horror movies | The ghost of little Lucy roams through the haunted valley | Get scared during movies

The Haunted Valley features an eerie environment that will give you the shivers. It's great for watching horror movies. This VR Cinema is haunted by little Lucy, the ghost of a 12 year old girl who disappeared in 1894. Lucy does not like it very much when strangers are around. Be prepared, as she will not hesitate to give you a scare once in a while. You can spot Lucy in four locations at random times if you keep your eyes peeled. [b]Are you ready for little Lucy?[/b]

WARNING! This VR Cinema is more scary than you might think. Be prepared!

[img]http://www.cineveovrcinema.com/images/hauntedvalley_screen_2.png[/img]
[img]http://www.cineveovrcinema.com/images/hauntedvalley_screen_3.png[/img]

notes.title: Update v1.9.10 FIXES choppy MKV video playback!
notes.content:
[h1][b][UPDATE - November 21st][/b][/h1]
All of CINEVEO's cinemas have been updated with the new MKV fix. More users have confirmed that MKVs play buttery smooth now. This has been tested with large file size 2D, 3D and 4K MKV video files. Hooray!!! ːsteamhappyː 

-----

[h1][b][UPDATE - November 20th][/b][/h1]
It was a long long struggle, but we believe we have finally solved the choppy MKV video playback issue! Users who participated in v1.9.10 BETA testing, have reported that MKV videos now play smoothly. This is not 100% confirmed yet, but you can test it yourself in the new v1.9.10 update (4D Movie Theater). [b][i]This fix only works in the 4D Movie Theater at the moment.[/i][/b]

If you try to play an MKV and it still stutters, try to restart the video a few times and see if it starts playing smoothly eventually. Please report in case this happens.

[h1][b]We look forward to everyone's feedback![/b][/h1]

notes.title: Update v1.9.9 makes CINEVEO easier to setup and more user-friendly
notes.content:
The new v1.9.9 updates makes CINEVEO ready to use, right out of the box. Users are no longer required to read a user manual or download video codecs from a website. The first time setup is much easier now and only takes a few seconds.

[h1]New features in v1.9.9[/h1]

- It is no longer necessary to manually download a video codec pack from Github. The video codec pack is now included in CINEVEO.

- Starting the app for the first time, CINEVEO verifies if the user has the required video codecs installed. If not, CINEVEO will automatically install the video codecs for the user.

- The user is now asked to click the CINEVEO app window at start. This guarantees that keyboard controls will be responsive.

- The VR file browser has a new indicator showing the user which keyboard keys he can use to search for video files more quickly than via gaze selection.

- Added a "User Manual" button in the file browser interface (Tunnel) to access the online version of the CINEVEO User Manual from within the app.

- After starting CINEVEO, it is no longer necessary to manually re-center the view to make the blue play-area line disappear.

- Added enhancements to the CINEVEO user guide.

notes.title: "5" Step Guide on how to use CINEVEO's Internet Cinema
notes.content:
To watch streaming video content (YouTube, Vimeo, etc.), CINEVEO has created the Internet Cinema. It features a fully functional web browser projected onto the cinema screen and social features such as multiplayer audience and chat room. This opens a wide range of possibilities! For example, you can share links to YouTube videos in the chat and then watch the videos together with other users. It’s even possible to play Flash or browser games together inside the VR Cinema.
  
[h1][b]HOW TO USE THE INTERNET CINEMA STEP BY STEP[/b][/h1]

[b]Step #1:[/b] “LAUNCH” the Internet Cinema in the STEAM client. The CINEVEO app window will open on the desktop and you will see the 4D Movie Theater with a white cinema screen, as well as a white interface below it (That’s the chat). Wait around 5 to 10 seconds until the cinema screen has loaded the “Homepage Menu” and the interface below shows the “Chat Room”. 

[b]Step #2:[/b] The Internet Cinema uses the mouse and keyboard, just like a normal web browser. Move the mouse pointer on your desktop above the CINEVEO app window and center it on the cinema screen. The windows mouse pointer will turn into a yellow dot, which you can move around on the cinema screen and chat room interface underneath.
  
[b]Step #3:[/b] The “Homepage Menu” serves as the address bar in a web browser. From here you can open websites and YouTube videos by typing or copy / pasting URLs into the “Website URL” and “YouTube Video URL” fields. You can also copy / paste URLs from a browser window on your desktop into the CINEVEO app window to make things easier. You can return to the “Homepage Menu” any time by pressing the [ F3 ] keyboard key. 

[b]Step #4:[/b] To open the “Chat Room Interface” look at the “Phone” located on the chair’s right armrest. In the chat you can talk to other users and do things like share and watch YouTube videos together. To watch a YouTube video, you should always copy / paste a YouTube video URL into the “YouTube Video URL field” on the “Homepage Menu”. This way the YouTube video will play in full screen HD. 

[b]Step #5:[/b] For more tips and tricks on how to use the Internet Cinema, check out the “Online User Guide”, which we always keep updating with new info, at the URL http://www.cineveovrcinema.com/vrbrowser_help.html
  
[h1][b]INTERNET CINEMA REQUIREMENTS[/b][/h1]

If videos don’t play in the Internet Cinema, you need to install the Firefox browser and install the Adobe Flash Player “with” Firefox.

[h1][b]CONTROL KEYS FOR THE INTERNET CINEMA[/b][/h1]

[F1] - Page back 
[F2] - Page forward 
[F3] - Homepage menu 
[F5] - Seat down 
[F6] - Seat up 
[F7] - Reset center orientation 
[ESC] - Exit CINEVEO

notes.title: Let's watch videos together! Join the Internet Cinema every day at 5pm (GMT).
notes.content:
Wouldn't it be cool to meet other CINEVEO user's to share and watch videos together? How about we try to make this happen?

Now that CINEVEO's Internet Cinema is upgraded with social features such as multiplayer audience and chat room, we are starting the "CINEVEO Video Meet-up Group"!

How does it work? Easy! All CINEVEO users are invited to join the Internet Cinema every day from 5pm to 6pm (GMT) to share and watch video clips on YouTube together and discuss them. The CINEVEO team will also be present!

If this is something you would like to participate in and have some ideas, please don't hesitate to share them.

notes.title: CINEVEO bug fix #3 update for HTC Vive released!
notes.content:
Thanks to Vive user feedback, we have finally been able to fix the issue with the video player controls interface (phone) crashing. This crash occurs when you try to select the "Menu" button in this interface. Instead of crashing the interface, this button would normally take you back to the tunnel to access the playlist and file browser to select another video to play.

The latest update should fix this issue in all cinema themes.

Most of the major issues in the Vive version of CINEVEO should now be fixed :)

notes.title: CINEVEO bug fix #2 update for HTC Vive released!
notes.content:
We believe that some of the issues user experience with the Vive are related to the way CINEVEO is launched through the Steam client. We made some changes to the launch options in the Steam client, which hopefully will solve some of these issues.

What is new:

- If you have the SteamVR client running, the blue play button in the Steam client should now say "PLAY IN VR" instead of "PLAY".

- When you launch one of CINEVEO themes in the launch options list, it will now say "CINEVEO - Virtual Reality Cinema" in the little SteamVR window instead of "Unresponsive".

- After launching the app you can now see the SteamVR dashboard and the CINEVEO connects to the Steam Community.

- Play time is finally being counted in every cinema theme !!!

- We also made sure that CINEVEO is launched at 64 Bit instead of 32 Bit, which hopefully removes the crashing issue for some.

[b]INTERNET CINEMA V0.5 BETA[/b]

SPECIAL FEATURES

[i]Built-in web browser | Streaming video (YouTube, Vimeo, etc.) | Surf the web | Play browser games | Multiplayer audience | Chat room | CINEVEO's Stereo PFOV lighting™[/i]

notes.title: The 1960 Drive-in Movie Theater v2.0 released now!
notes.content:
We are super excited to announce the v1.9.2 update of CINEVEO for the HTC Vive and the Oculus Rift! This update adds the 1960 Drive-in Movie Theater v2.0 with support for SteamVR and the Consumer Rift.

[b]1960 DRIVE-IN THEATER V2.0[/b]

SPECIAL FEATURES

[i]Ultra-detailed 1960s drive-in movie theater setting | Sit in a 1958 Buick convertible | Air traffic and animated birds | Vertigo effect[/i]

Inspired by the 1960's drive-in cinemas that were all the rage throughout the United States, CINEVEO's 1960 Drive-in Movie Theater v2.0 is the most detailed VR cinema environment ever created. You get to watch your movies in your personal drive-in movie theater, located on a vast hill overseeing the Los Angeles city skyline at night. You get to sit inside an ultra-detailed 1958 Buick convertible car with a fully modeled interior and exterior. notes.title: CINEVEO bug fix #1 update for HTC Vive released!
notes.content:
Some HTC Vive users have reported CINEVEO crashing for them or the Vive head tracking becoming unresponsive when they enter the cinema. This issue was caused by a conflict with the integrated Vive camera and the webcam display in the cinema.

The bug fix #1 update disables the webcam display by default to prevent this conflict. To activate the webcam display without causing conflicts, attach an external USB webcam to your PC and press the [ W ] keyboard key anytime when you are in the cinema.

notes.title: CINEVEO v1.9.1 update adds Consumer Rift and Oculus SDK v1.3 support
notes.content:
We are excited to announce the release of the CINEVEO v1.9.1 update for the Oculus Rift. This update includes the amazing 4D Movie Theater v4.0 and The Void v3.0 cinema themes with Consumer Rift support.

[h1][b]WHAT'S NEW IN V1.9.1?[/b][/h1]

[b]This release adds the 4D Movie Theater v4.0[/b]

• The 4D Movie Theater has been updated with Oculus v1.3 SDK and Consumer Rift support. It also works great with the DK2.

• We created an innovative new dynamic lighting technique (CINEVEO’s Stereo PFOV Lighting), which creates an intense atmosphere inside the movie theater using light, colors, reflections and shadows. This effect can be seen especially well during action scenes with a lot of screen flashing (explosions, fire, etc.). The best position to see this effect is the last row of the movie theater, with the theater walls partially visible in the peripheral field of vision.

• Lots of graphics enhancements.

• Improved sense of scale, depth and immersion. Sitting in the 4D Movie Theater feels so real, it’s almost scary.
 
• Enhancements to multiplayer audience. CINEVEO users can now see other users from both the Android Cardboard and Oculus Rift version of CINEVEO sit around in the movie theater.

• Improved contrast and color saturation. Since the black smearing issue has been partially fixed in the consumer rift, we have decided to disable the black smearing correction. Now black is 100% black and colors appear more saturated. However, there is now a bit of black smearing in the DK2.

[b]This release adds The Void v3.0 cinema theme[/b]

• The Void cinema theme has been updated with Oculus v1.3 SDK andConsumer Rift support. It also works great with the DK2.

• Added CINEVEO’s new ULTRA - 3D mode. This new mode enhances the perceived depth and immersion of any 3D SBS or Over / Under movie to such a degree, that you feel as if you are literally inside the movie! An amazing new way to experience 3D movies. ULTRA - 3D works best with 3D videos in UHD (4K) resolution.

How to watch a 3D movie in ULTRA - 3D? 
Play a 3D video file, preferably in UHD (4K) resolution, in The Void v3.0 cinema theme. Choose the curved cinema screen and then enlarge the cinema screen with the (PageUp) key so much that you can no longer see the edges of the cinema screen when you look at the center of it. You will notice that with every PageUp key press, you emerge more and more into the movie. Welcome to ULTRA - 3D!

• Added support for users with vision impairment. These users now have the option to make the cinema screen extremely large, which helps them make out the details in a video.

[h1][b]FREE BONUS!!! This release also adds CINEVEO for Android Cardboard[/b][/h1]

• CINEVEO STEAM users now have free access to the full version of CINEVEO for Android Cardboard. The Android APK's are in the CINEVEO installation directory. Three VR Cinemas are available for Android; The 4D Movie Theater, The 1960s Drive-in Movie Theater and the Ocean Theater.

notes.title: CINEVEO v1.8.1 update adds v0.7 Runtime and Windows 10 support!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce the first Windows 10 compatible version of CINEVEO!

We have upgraded the 4D Movie Theater v3.0 BETA with the Oculus v0.7.0 SDK, which adds Windows 10 support.

Unfortunately, due to bugs and limitations in the Oculus v0.7.0 SDK and Unity's new built-in VR support, it's not possible to watch 3D movies in this BETA. There are also some graphic issues with the real-time reflections and the app sometimes crashes when exiting it. Luckily, everything else seems to function correctly. That's pretty good if you consider that the Oculus v0.7.0 SDK is only a BETA and the first Runtime ever to support Windows 10.

IMPORTANT !!!

Before you upgrade to Windows 10, be aware of the possible risks. Carefully study the minimum requirements of the v0.7.0 Runtime on the Oculus website. To be able to run the v0.7.0 Runtime on Windows 10, you need to have certain graphic cards and drivers. Rift support on Windows 10 is limited at the moment. If you don't inform yourself, you might end up upgrading to Windows 10 just to discover that you cannot use your Rift anymore.

notes.title: CINEVEO received a major update today!
notes.content:
Today, we are excited to announce the release of the biggest update CINEVEO has received since the addition of the 60s Drive-In Theater! In the new v1.8.0 update, the 4D Movie Theater v2.0 is retired and replaced by the 4D Movie Theater v3.0. The new v3.0 is a complete re-build with Unity 5 and the Oculus v0.6.0 SDK. It comes with many new features, such as a AAA graphics upgrade, advanced dynamic lighting with reflections and shape drawing, an innovative Stereo PFOV lighting technique we invented that extends the movie experience beyond the edges of the cinema screen using your peripheral vision, new hands-free controls, more functionalities and is Rift CV1 ready.

[b]VERSION 1.8.0[/b]

- The 4D Movie Theater v2.0 is retired and replaced by the 4D Movie Theater v3.0. The new v3.0 features AAA graphics, Oculus v0.6.0 SDK, advanced dynamic lighting with reflections and is Rift CV1 ready.

- Upgraded to Unity 5, making use of all the new features and goodies.

- Native Oculus Runtime v0.6.0 support.

- AAA graphics upgrade. Ultra-realism, Ultra-immersion. Now you really feel like being in a movie theater.

- New dynamic lighting engine casts the cinema screen’s light, color, reflections, shapes and shadows throughout the movie theater.

- Innovative new Stereo PFV (Peripheral Field of View) Lighting. We invented a new dynamic lighting technique that utilizes your blurry peripheral vision (What your eyes see at the edges of your field of view). This new technique creates a mesmerizing special effect, which extends the movie watching experience beyond the cinema screen and into the movie theater. It will feel like the movie is actually taking place inside the movie theater. This effect can only be seen from the start position chair (last row chair) and is best visible during action scenes and explosions. You will see the effect when you keep focusing at the center of the cinema screen and see part of the left and right wall of the movie theater in your peripheral vision.

- New hands-free gaze controls with new design.

- Added new functions to the video player hands-free interface (fast forward / rewind 10 seconds or 1 minute, lighting toggle, go to movie selection zone, exit the app, current time).

- Added a new movie selection hands-free interface that lets you switch video files inside the movie theater. The new movie selection interface opens when you look at the popcorn box to the left of you.

- Graphically enhanced movie selection zone.

- Added tunnel fly-through animation to movie selection zone.

- Added a file filter to the VR File Browser. Now only lists folders and video files. Other files are filtered out.
